messages:
Ravi: Huge thanks to Ava and Sam for jumping on the support burst earlier. You two unblocked the sales demo in <5 mins — unreal :sparkling_heart:
Ava: Team effort! Sam found the bad env var that was toggling the cache off. Wild how one char can cause chaos.
Sam: Yep, `REDWOOD_CACHE_ENABLE=false` was the culprit. Changed it back, green again.
Lena: Mad props — also thanks for walking the sales engineer through the workaround so they could continue the demo. Calm and clear explanations win every time.
Ravi: Sending virtual high fives. Also, small request: can we add the env var checklist to the demo playbook? Saved us a scramble tonight.
Ava: On it. Ill add a 3-line note with the most common env gotchas and link to the `dev/ops` snippet.
ops-bot: Incident #2033-02 resolved by Sam, Ava. Duration: 7m. Severity: low. Tags: cache, demo.
Sam: If anyones around the kitchen tomorrow morning, Im bringing a box of donuts as thanks :doughnut:
Lena: Donuts + postmortem checklist = perfect combo :100:
Ravi: Officially endorsing donuts. Thank you all — seriously appreciated. These quick saves keep the product looking polished in front of customers.
